visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of the forest floor, where a thick, weathered yellow rope with distinct black and red electrical tape markers lies on the damp, dark soil. Small saplings, supported by thin bamboo stakes, are scattered in the background amidst green grass and forest debris under diffused, overcast daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of three men standing in a clearing; an older Asian man in an orange high-visibility vest and a grey beanie under a safety helmet stands on the left, while two younger Black men wearing safety helmets with clear visors and red-palmed work gloves stand to the right. They are surrounded by misty mountain scenery and partially cleared forest land. (3) A sequence of cuts shows the men engaged in conversation, with the older man gesturing toward the ground and the saplings while the others listen intently. Large yellow and red variety-show text overlays pop up periodically at the bottom and center of the frame to emphasize their dialogue. (4) The camera focuses on the hands of the individuals as they use a black marker to write on white tags attached to the young trees; one man wears a white Adidas jacket, another an olive green hoodie. (5) The final phase shows the trio laughing and joking together in the foggy mountain environment, with the camera capturing their expressive facial reactions and playful hand gestures as they discuss the long-term growth of the trees they just planted.
